name: Ribbed Cashmere Turtleneck
description: A ribbed cashmere turtleneck sweater in a warm oatmeal-cream, with a fine vertical rib knit, a folded mock collar, and a relaxed close-fitting silhouette.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, embroidery, or printed marking anywhere on the sweater; never change the rib gauge, add cable patterns, or alter the collar height; never shift the oatmeal-cream color toward white, beige, or grey. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the fine vertical rib knit, warm oatmeal-cream tone, and turtleneck collar height identical and consistent across every angle; knit gauge, fiber texture, and color must match exactly from front to back to detail to on-form.
